# Pack catalog

Every industry pack in `packs/` with its templates and slots, generated from each `pack.yaml` (12 packs). Create an episode from a template with `reelforge new <id> --pack <pack> --template <template> --lang en|ar`, from the dashboard (**New from template**) or with the `create_from_template` tool. See [Templates and packs](../guide/templates-and-packs.md).

| Pack                                                       | Theme        | Templates                                                      | Description                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Education](#education) (`education`)                      | `campus`     | `concept-explainer`, `study-plan`, `enrollment-steps`          | Explain one concept, share a study plan or walk students through enrollment.                                      |
| [Events & non-profits](#events-ngo) (`events-ngo`)         | `editorial`  | `donation-impact`, `event-agenda`, `volunteer-signup`          | Honest, human videos about where donations go, an event day and how to volunteer.                                 |
| [Finance](#finance) (`finance`)                            | `ledger`     | `budget-basics`, `compound-interest`, `scam-alert`             | Budget basics, compound interest and scam alerts with example values. For information only, not financial advice. |
| [Food & hospitality](#food) (`food`)                       | `bistro`     | `dish-in-steps`, `order-to-table`, `weekly-menu`               | Show how a dish is made, how an order reaches the table and this week's specials. No health claims.               |
| [Government & public services](#government) (`government`) | `civic`      | `renew-document`, `appointment-checklist`, `program-deadlines` | Step-by-step guides to renewals, appointments and program deadlines. Neutral, plain and accessible.               |
| [Healthcare](#healthcare) (`healthcare`)                   | `clinical`   | `patient-journey`, `department-intro`, `health-tip`            | Patient guides for a hospital or clinic. General information only, never medical advice.                          |
| [Manufacturing](#manufacturing) (`manufacturing`)          | `industrial` | `part-journey`, `safety-mistake`, `downtime-causes`            | How a part is made, a safety rule and where line time goes. Follow your site's official procedures.               |
| [Ports & logistics](#ports-logistics) (`ports-logistics`)  | `harbor`     | `container-journey`, `terminal-in-numbers`, `new-route`        | Explain how cargo moves through a port, share terminal numbers and announce new routes.                           |
| [Real estate](#real-estate) (`real-estate`)                | `estate`     | `property-tour`, `neighborhood-guide`, `buying-steps`          | Property tours, neighborhood guides and buyer steps for an agency or developer.                                   |
| [Retail](#retail) (`retail`)                               | `retail`     | `click-and-collect`, `returns-steps`, `loyalty-program`        | Explain store services in short, upbeat steps. Prices and conditions exactly as you provide them.                 |
| [Tech & software](#tech) (`tech`)                          | `default`    | `system-concept`, `latency-numbers`, `request-path`            | System design concepts, latency numbers and a request's path through the stack. Generic technologies only.        |
| [Tourism & travel](#tourism) (`tourism`)                   | `voyage`     | `itinerary-3-days`, `airport-to-town`, `best-time-to-visit`    | Short travel guides with practical tips. Times, prices and rules only as you provide them.                        |

## Education {#education}

- Theme: `campus`
